Caught On Camera, Total Lunatic Driver Swerves Into Oncoming Traffic To Beat Queue As Viewers Demand “Jail Time Before He Kills Someone”
Audio By Carbonatix
An infuriating dashcam video has captured the moment a reckless driver gambles with lives by veering into oncoming traffic to bypass a line of cars, triggering a series of terrifying near head-on collisions.
The shocking clip, which has racked up more than three million views online, shows the motorist cruising along a divided highway in broad daylight before suddenly crossing over into the opposing lanes in a desperate bid to dodge heavy traffic.
With cars, vans and other vehicles hurtling toward him at speed, the driver continues down the wrong side of the road, forcing oncoming motorists to swerve out of the way to avoid a catastrophic crash.
At multiple points, the vehicle appears seconds away from a deadly head-on collision, with barely any room to maneuver as traffic approaches from the opposite direction.
Adding a bizarre twist to the already horrifying footage, the video is overlaid with motivational audio praising risk taking and pushing limits, glorifying the idea of doing the “impossible” even as the driver places countless lives in danger.
The contrast has only fueled outrage online.
Viewers flooded the comments with fury, with many calling for the driver to be identified and punished severely. Demands ranged from immediate license revocation to jail time, with some warning that it is only a matter of time before such behavior ends in tragedy.
